The +339% socket rise (E1) fits connections being held longer by delayed responses. Exhaustion would produce connection errors, but errors stayed 0.0 (E2) and all 56371 logs are successful info lines (E3).

proposed_fix.description: Remove the injected network delay (e.g., the tc/netem qdisc or chaos experiment) on currencyservice's network interface. Then verify that inbound call latency to currencyservice returns to its ~5ms p50 baseline and that frontend p90 latency recovers.
